title: Video by brezojr
description:
Sometimes I look back at where I started and it doesn’t even feel real.

In 2017, I was just a kid who decided to start MMA. I was training at the gym, learning everything from scratch and dreaming about where this sport could take me.

I had no idea how many years of training, losses, sacrifices, injuries and doubts were ahead of me. There were plenty of moments when I questioned myself, but I kept showing up.

Now it’s 2026. 3-0 as a pro, 32-13 as an amateur, and I’m still chasing the same dream I had back then.

Still that kid who wanted to become a fighter. Just with a lot more experience behind him.
